capability: Every fix ships with a check that fails first
title: The old bug hits a gate.

hook.picture: Close: the whale smooths a wobble out of the line. Later the same wobble swims back in and a pod answers ✕.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: We fixed that bug in May. It came back in March.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: engineer, reading a reopened bug report

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Across a long line of edits, the same wobble returns three times, faster each time. Each fix leaves no trace.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Nothing remembered what the old bug looked like.

stakes.body: Fixed bugs come back, and each one is paid for twice: once to fix it and once to find it again.

solution_hint: Keep the old bug. Make it fail.

metaphor.body: Keep the old bug as a ghost run. Build a gate that stops the ghost before the fix ships, so the bug can never swim back in unnoticed.

steps.picture: The whale copies the wobbly run into a ghost line and keeps it.
It builds a gate with the wobble icon and replays the ghost. The bar drops: the check fails on the old copy first.
steps.words: Test against the old bug first.
steps.sound: Stop knock on the low note

steps.picture: Push-in: the fixed line passes the same gate and the opening glows.
The ghost is filed beside the gate as a tick.
steps.words: Fail on the old copy. Then pass.

steps.picture: New runs flow through, and the wobble gate checks each one.
The old wobble swims in again and bounces off the gate.
steps.sound: Bounce, then the figure going up

real_case.claim: Three fixers on disjoint files went A 0/22 → 22/22, B 0/15 → 15/15 and C 0/16 → 16/16, under the rule that every fix ships with a check that fails on the old copy.

honest_limit.picture: A colour fault, in the old wobble's exact spot, passes the wobble gate cleanly. The pod answers ✕.
honest_limit.words: It only knows the bug it saw.

not_this.body: One old bug stopped. Not every bug.

ending_pattern.body: The old wobble swims back in exactly as in bar 2, hits the gate that was built from it, bounces off and dissolves. The pod answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: Same framing and the same wobble as bar 2: this time it never reaches the pod.

end_belief.body: Every fix ships with its failing check.

score_self.reason: Fail-first is pictured before it is named, and the callback is exact. The counter fraction may not read at a glance for non-engineers.
